004.text: After a few days, the sky returns to normal.

006.text:
Ever since atempting to stop the incident, Reimu has
			been under a heavy fever.

008.name: Marisa
008.text: Reimu? Are feeling better yet, Reimu.

009.name: Reimu
009.text: Nooooo. Let me rest some more.

012.name: Reimu
012.text: Mmmm. I'll be up in a moment.

013.name: Marisa
013.text:
You know, many in the village 
			are still sick, even more than you.

014.name: Marisa
014.text:
I don't know what that mist did, but
			it was definitely no good.

015.name: Marisa
015.text: Must be pretty powerful to take you out.

016.name: Marisa
016.text: Luckily I stayed indoors the whole time.

017.name: Reimu
017.text: If you had gone with me, maybe we could've stopped them.

018.name: Marisa
018.text: Oi, I was busy vampire proofing my house.

019.name: Marisa
019.text:
Anyway, I've also come to tell you that the villagers
			are lining outside your shrine again.

020.name: Marisa
020.text: They are looking for miracle healing.

021.name: Reimu
021.text:
Tell them I'll be out in a bit
			after this headache subsides.

022.name: Marisa
022.text: You'll get more donations if you answer their prayers faster.

023.name: Reimu
023.text:
I'd rather not have the whole village be sick.
			I prefer my shrine being more quiet.

024.name: Marisa
024.text: Alright, I'll tell them to go home. I be back tomorrow.

027.text:
Try for a Single Credit Clear for the true end!
			Or move on to the Extra Stage to continue the story.
